decided: A sensor fires when any goal or ruling in the architecture doc a change belongs to is changed, removed or added after building began, unless a stop asking to amend a ruling or goal was written and answered by the user in that time. An unanswered stop does not count.
alternatives: ignore new rulings and watch only edits to existing ones
compare against the doc as at the last architect session
why: Changing the program's rules is a stop the AI already owes, so this checks that it happened; a new ruling an AI adds can loosen the rules as much as an edit can.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course.
The moment a change's building begins, after which its plan no longer changes; a sensor compares against the plan and settings as they stood then.
